designationHistory.name: Kofa Game Range
designationHistory.indexText: Established Jan. 25, 1939, as the Kofa Game Range by Executive Order 8039, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt, to protect desert bighorn sheep.

American Presidency Project: Executive Order 8039, Jan. 25, 1939

review.note: Year confirmed; adds date, the earlier name Kofa Game Range, EO 8039 and FDR.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Kofa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1939 for the protection of desert bighorn sheep and other native wildlife following a 1936 campaign by the Arizona Boy Scouts.
